preamble: Extreme macro photography, 100mm macro lens. Razor-thin plane of focus, everything else falling to soft darkness. Backlit so edges glow. Visible surface texture and grain of the material. Deep negative space. Photographic realism, no CGI, no illustration, no text, no logos, no watermark.

images.scene: A half-finished evening dress of deep emerald green silk satin on a tailor's dress form, the bodice hand-basted with pale thread, a few pearl-headed pins in the shoulder seam, a yellow cloth tape measure hanging over the shoulder of the form, the silk falling in long smooth folds that catch the light. Behind, far out of focus, bolts of jewel-coloured silk (sapphire, ruby, gold) on the shelves of a warm tailoring workroom. Close framing on the bodice and shoulder of the dress form, which stands in the right third of the frame; the left two thirds of the frame fall into deep soft warm darkness with only a faint glow of the workroom, a large empty dark space for text. Low warm backlight from behind the form so the edges of the silk folds and the pins glow. No people, no faces, no head on the dress form, no hands, no text, no labels, no logos.
